_: Vector ledger: one row per seam. Every scene change is a shared-element morph, never a cut or a crossfade; the outgoing element is still travelling on the cut frame and the incoming one enters on the same axis. exit/entry must agree; every exit has a tl.set hard kill with the same selector string on the cut frame. Keep them matched when you retime anything.

seams.technique: zoom-through (scene flies past the camera, blur peaks on the cut; next scene arrives from behind, 0.92 → 1)
edge-on collapse → unfold (cards scaleX → 0.02; terminal unfolds scaleX 0.03 → 1 on the same axis)
dock (modal wrap shrinks to 0.5 and blurs; the mascot stage grows from 0.5 on a spring)
conveyor off the top (bars y → −140) → the command pill rises from below (y 140 → 0) on a spring
